instruction: Enable notification sounds for incoming alerts.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling notification sounds via GNOME settings. The setup disables event-sounds, and the agent must enable it using gsettings command. The evaluator verifies the setting is enabled by reading the gsettings value.
metadata.verification: The evaluator uses existing vm_command_line getter and exact_match metric. Expected output is 'true\n' when the setting is enabled.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts the GNOME desktop sound event-sounds setting, which is exactly what the instruction requires to verify notification sounds are enabled
Metric uses exact_match comparison which is appropriate for boolean gsettings values
Expected value 'true\n' is semantically correct and matches the actual output format of gsettings command (includes newline)
Complete coverage: instruction has one requirement (enable notification sounds) and evaluator checks this requirement
Correct data flow: setup disables setting, agent should enable it, evaluator verifies it's enabled
No state timing issues: gsettings values are persistent and don't require UI to be open, no postconfig needed
Runtime feasibility confirmed: get_vm_command_line executes command via HTTP POST to VM, exact_match performs simple equality check
